objective.text: Reject a path traversal segment rather than allowing a storage key to escape its disk root.

difficulty.rationale: Recognize the disk boundary when an input attempts to traverse above its root.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The standard local Flysystem adapter is used; no custom path normalizer is installed.

stem: What happens when Storage::disk("local")->put("../outside.txt", "x") attempts to escape the disk root?

options.text: The file is written one directory above the configured root.
options.rationale: The disk abstraction does not grant arbitrary parent-directory traversal through this key.
options.misconception: The disk abstraction does not grant arbitrary parent-directory traversal through this key.

options.text: Path normalization rejects the traversal with an exception.
options.rationale: Flysystem rejects a parent traversal that would move above the root; it is not a permitted relative storage key.

options.text: The leading ../ is silently removed and outside.txt is stored at the root.
options.rationale: An escaping parent segment is rejected rather than automatically sanitized into a different valid key.
options.misconception: An escaping parent segment is rejected rather than automatically sanitized into a different valid key.

options.text: Laravel creates a new disk named outside and writes there.
options.rationale: Path strings do not dynamically define filesystem disks.
options.misconception: Path strings do not dynamically define filesystem disks.
